technique_name: Devise a strategic plan for a fashion brand to increase its online presence.
description: The strategic plan for the fashion brand should include setting up an online presence on major social media platforms (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, Twitter) and creating engaging content which could include news on fashion trends and tips, interviews of fashion designers, and visuals of the fashion products in action.
